newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Freegold Western Holdings mine hit by fire.
newsitem.headline: Freegold Western Holdings mine hit by fire.

text.p: South Africa's Free State Consolidated Gold Mines Ltd (Freegold) said on Tuesday that a fire at its Western Holdings No 1 shaft had hit gold production.
The mine said it had lost six kg of gold production worth 300,000 rand so far, but there could be further losses.
"Until such time as the fire is sealed management cannot quantify the total production loss," the mine said.
Freegold said the fire was still burning and specialised fire-fighting teams were battling to contain it. The fire is burning on the shaft's 32 level about 905 metres below ground.
No one has been injured in the blaze.
"The shaft's main shaft has been affected. However, work on the sub-vertical shaft continues unaffected," the mine said.
Neither Monday night's shift nor Tuesday's shift were able to go underground.
The main shaft contributes 138 kg of gold to Freegold's total monthly production of anout 6,500 kg.
Freegold is part of the Anglo American Corp of South Africa stable of mines.
Last year it suffered the closure of some of its unproductive and unprofitable shafts.
